minor.issue: Rollback restores previous_version without checking that the config's current version still equals this record's released_version. Rolling back an older config change after a newer change to the same key was released silently reverts the newer release. Should 409 (stale_rollback) or require a new change.

Approval stores amount 0 and no snapshot of change_summary / proposed_value / current-vs-proposed diff; second admin approves without seeing what is being released on the approval page (only via parent link).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Submit appeal' (action-btn-request_review) still shown while an appeal is already open; backend correctly rejects with 409 'An appeal is already open for this case.' - hide the action when an open appeal child exists.

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Stale-rollback risk: a_cfg_rollback restores rec.previous_version unconditionally; reproduce by releasing CFG-A then CFG-B on same key, then rollback CFG-A -> CFG-B's value is lost. Mitigation: in rollback pre-hook, fail 409 if db.config[key].version != rec.released_version.
